summary.text: Jonah Garson is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 23 and is seeking election to the seat on November 3, 2026, against Republican Laura Pichardo.
An attorney and vice chair of the Democratic Party of North Carolina, he was appointed to the Senate in April 2026.

paragraphs.text: Garson was born in Chapel Hill and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2009 and a law degree from Columbia Law School in 2014, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.
Garson was appointed to the District 23 seat on April 10, 2026, succeeding Graig Meyer.

Chapelboro reported, as cited by Ballotpedia, that the state Democratic Party committee selected Garson as the party's nominee to replace Meyer in the general election; Ballotpedia says Meyer resigned to become executive director of the North Carolina Justice Center.

The General Assembly's website lists the district as covering Caswell, Orange and Person counties and shows his committee assignments in Appropriations on General Government and Information Technology, Commerce and Insurance, Regulatory Reform, and State and Local Government.
